posts.title: Picture of the week. No.10
posts.description: On a trip to Deauville in France some time back, it was a lovely day in the beach. This beach hut caught my eye against the sea and the sand. Its an old picture but worthy of a picture of the week. It just so happens that Deauville is the twin town of where I live, East Cowes on the Isle of Wight.

posts.title: Selling more photos...
posts.description: I think I've lost my way. Today I sold another rollercoaster picture on Alamy...! . I didn't intend, or think that I would sell any at all.
